typography.family_appearance: modern grotesk sans-serif; clear Simplified Chinese sans-serif
typography.main_title: regular to medium, approximately 132-160 px at the default canvas, adjusted for title length

editorial.instructions: Keep the fixed two-column master: about 3% exterior margins, 25% left text column, 3% gutter and 66% right explanatory area. Use a fine vertical separator. The left contains a large, regular-to-medium title, a concise summary and exactly one takeaway. The right holds the content in declared section order. A process can wrap with a visible continuation arrow. Do not put an enormous full-width title above this layout. Keep the same visual frame across topics; node count and flow direction adapt to the actual content.

chapters.instructions: Use the chapter master: a full-width heading followed by spacious horizontal chapter bands separated by fine rules. Within each band put a large section number, heading and explanation on the left, and its technical relations on the right. Connect cross-section flows explicitly. Use the actual declared number of sections; do not add a fake third stage. Preserve the shared palette and lighter typography.

lanes.instructions: Use the lane master: compact full-width title above clearly named horizontal lanes. Each lane represents an actual actor or execution phase. Keep node titles and short descriptions visible; use fine routed arrows between lanes. Feedback must identify its actor and action. Do not assume every topic has offline and online stages. Preserve the shared palette and lighter typography.
